SY314
Time Diaries and Content Analysis
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
provides
students
with a deeper understanding of research methods through learning about two methods of data collection and analysis: time use data and content analysis. Students will learn how to collect and analyze time diary and textual data, including online content.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY280
(or one of
CS235
,
PO217
, PS291, or
PS295
); and
SY281
Exclusions
SY309F.
